title: Recording for Harry Lim and 300-400 sides in the 1940s
summary: Stewart recorded often for Harry Lim, including sessions with Johnny Guarnieri, and estimates hundreds of sides with Tatum, Goodman, Parker, Gillespie and others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You played on some of the Harry Lim -- Harry Lim used to have like jam sessions, didn't he?

That's right. Jam sessions and of course, I recorded for Harry Lim, made quite a few records for him. I think a few of them we recorded -- that I recorded were with Johnny Guarnieri on piano and what have you.
What kind of -- oh, excuse me. Go ahead.
I was trying to think. Also it brings back a beautiful memory. I had Johnny Guarnieri playing piano for me also in one of my groups.

And speaking of recordings, I can't put my finger on it, but I must have recorded well over 300 to 400 sides with different groups, which, if I can remember, included Slim and Slam, Art Tatum, Dizzy Gillespie, Benny Goodman, Charlie Parker, Johnny Guarnieri, Hot Lips Page and so many more, I can't remember. But I recorded --
Yes, I was, especially during the '40s. That was a big year.
Well, now, what kind of a guy was Harry Lim? I mean, was he Chinese-American or was he --
Was he a little bit more honest than Timmie Rosenkrantz?
I think he was a little more honest, yes.
